site decides

The site picks the videos itself — the player just renders them

Blue Billywig demo · live walk-through
In plain English: Some websites already run their own clever recommendation system. In that case we let the site take over completely: it hands the player a ready-made list of videos, and the player simply shows them at the end. Toggle the checkboxes on the right and watch the post-roll panel match your picks exactly.

Try it. Tick or untick clips on the right, hit Push to player, then Skip to end →. Use Clear override to hand control back to the smart playlist.
